codeReviewFindings.title: Production Payment API trusts a repo-committed symmetric JWT signing key
codeReviewFindings.trigger: Non-Development start with Jwt:SecretKey from appsettings (compose overrides Issuer only)
codeReviewFindings.actual: SymmetricSecurityKey configured unconditionally in Program.cs:56-72; any holder of the public repo key can mint HS256 tokens for iss=SmartParking.UserService
codeReviewFindings.impact: Impersonation of any role including money-bearing internal endpoints
codeReviewFindings.criterion: coding skill security: no insecure symmetric/default trust. Not introduced by this branch (file is unmodified; literal key is pre-existing tracked content).

codeReviewFindings.title: Deposit-order endpoints remain on the loose default scheme
codeReviewFindings.trigger: Any caller presenting a SERVICE/OPERATIONS_WORKER/INTERNAL_SERVICE role or scope=s2s claim; in Development any nonblank X-Internal-Service-Key
codeReviewFindings.expected: Dedicated Operations identity with Payment-specific audience and narrow reservation permission
codeReviewFindings.actual: Broad policy over a symmetric-key-capable default scheme; DevAuthenticationHandler accepts any Bearer string and spoofable X-Actor-* headers
codeReviewFindings.impact: Over-privileged machine access to order creation/replay and collection lookup

codeReviewFindings.title: EnsureOrder does not bind the full immutable quote
codeReviewFindings.trigger: PUT /internal/reservation-deposit-orders/{operationId} with a quote whose site/tenant/currency/terms differ but amount matches
codeReviewFindings.expected: Compare all price inputs and require H <= quote.ValidUntil
codeReviewFindings.actual: Only Status, AccountId, DepositAmount (and expiry) checked; replay compares ReferenceId+AccountId+Amount only
codeReviewFindings.impact: Order can be bound to wrong site/tenant/currency; same operationId with different scope silently returns the original order

codeReviewFindings.title: Concurrent same-idempotency-key EnsureOrder returns 500
codeReviewFindings.trigger: Two concurrent PUTs with the same operationId
codeReviewFindings.expected: Replay the same order (or 409 on payload mismatch)
codeReviewFindings.actual: Read-then-insert without transaction/advisory lock; unique violation surfaces as 500 INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR
codeReviewFindings.impact: Caller cannot distinguish created from transient failure; may strand a paid hold

codeReviewFindings.title: Quote acceptance is not serialized
codeReviewFindings.trigger: Two different operationIds for one quoteId
codeReviewFindings.actual: No FOR UPDATE, no unique constraint on payment_orders.quoteId -> two orders; impact double-charge risk

codeReviewFindings.title: Deploying this branch rejects webhooks for pre-existing checkouts
codeReviewFindings.trigger: PayOS callback for an order created before the binding feature deployed
codeReviewFindings.actual: Missing binding -> InvalidCallback 401 INVALID_WEBHOOK_SIGNATURE on every retry
codeReviewFindings.impact: Paid orders never confirmed without manual reconciliation
codeReviewFindings.criterion: each verified collection must be recorded

codeReviewFindings.title: Checkout signing bindings stored in the pricing policy_revisions table
codeReviewFindings.actual: One permanent TARIFF/GLOBAL row per order code in the pricing table
codeReviewFindings.impact: Unbounded growth in a pricing-owned table; a future prune deletes live signing bindings; contradicts the followup proposal not to overload policy history

testSensitivityVerdicts.checkoutBindingOutboundOrderingTests: PROVEN for all three tests. Binding moved after SendAsync fails each test (blocked-store timeout / missing read / Calls==0 assert). Un-awaited store fails deterministically. Storage failure with outbound traffic is caught by Assert.Equal(0, handler.Calls). A swallowed assertion cannot become a false PASS because XunitException is neither HttpRequestException nor OperationCanceledException (PayOsAdapter.cs:306-307) and the external flags are set after the assertion and then asserted.
testSensitivityVerdicts.pgIndependentConnectionTest: PARTIALLY PROVEN. Ordering and decryption at the outbound boundary are proven (fresh PaymentDbContext + fresh CheckoutSigningBindings inside SendAsync). Commit isolation and connection independence are NOT discriminated: the reader rents from the same Npgsql pool, there is no pg_backend_pid inequality, no Pooling=false and no pre-opened independent connection, so a never-committed transaction would still pass. Rename to ...ReadableByFreshContext... or force a distinct connection.
testSensitivityVerdicts.postmanTermsGuardTest: PROVEN. With snapshot_fixture_ready=true and a 503 response, the script produces exactly one outcome named "terms review succeeds" with passed=false, and environment.set is never called, so accepted terms cannot be captured from an error response.
testSensitivityVerdicts.liveTermsRecheck: Executed through the real collection against the running services: HTTP 503, 1 failed assertion, 0 test-script failures, 0 prerequest failures.
